title: President and Prime Minister Visit New Gendarmerie Leadership
summary: President Jimmy Jimmies and Prime Minister obvelt recently visited the new command of the Gendarmerie to meet with officers, observe their work, and discuss the progress being made under the new leadership.
body:
The visit was also an opportunity to show support for the newly appointed command and the work being carried out by its officers.

Following the visit, the President expressed his confidence in the future of the force:

***“I wish the best of luck to the new leadership of the Gendarmerie. Always good to stop by and talk to the officers. The Gendarmerie will be the pride of our law enforcement once again.”***

The visit comes as the Gendarmerie continues to develop under its new command, following alongated periods of inactivity from its predecessors. Early impressions of the work and progress made so far have been highly positive, with the leadership appearing determined to strengthen the force and restore it to it's former glory.
